paper.title_en: Edge observables in Maxwell theory on null boundaries
paper.abstract_en: We study edge observables in three-dimensional Maxwell theory on null boundaries using a Hamiltonian formulation adapted to null foliations. We consider three backgrounds: Minkowski spacetime, the BTZ black hole, and de Sitter space, where the relevant boundaries are, respectively, null infinity, the black hole horizon, and the cosmological horizon. In all three cases we find, besides the usual $\mathrm U(1)$ charge, a second edge observable associated with a shift transformation intrinsic to the null boundary. The two charges are well defined quasilocally. They form a centrally extended algebra which, in Fourier modes, becomes two independent Abelian Kac--Moody algebras with opposite levels. Thus, the same centrally extended edge structure appears at both asymptotic and finite distance null boundaries. The phase space also admits charge-conjugation twisted configurations, in which the modes of the algebra are half-integer. Finally, in Minkowski spacetime we find an exact radiative solution in this twisted sector, with both charges nonvanishing.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该文研究零类边界上的麦克斯韦理论边缘可观测量（U(1)荷、Kac–Moody代数、中心扩张），属于规范理论/边界对称性而非引力动力学基础；与度规仿射引力、Palatini引力及修改引力等目标主题均无实质关联，故不入选。
decision.title_zh: 零类边界上麦克斯韦理论的边缘可观测量
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在三维麦克斯韦理论中，采用适配零叶状结构的哈密顿形式，研究零类边界上的边缘可观测量。我们考虑三个背景：闵可夫斯基时空、BTZ黑洞与de Sitter空间，其相应边界分别为零类无穷远、黑洞视界与宇宙学视界。在这三种情形中，除通常的 $\mathrm U(1)$ 荷之外，我们还发现第二个边缘可观测量，它与零类边界内禀的平移变换相关联。这两个荷在准局域意义下定义良好。它们构成一个中心扩张代数，在傅里叶模式中成为两个级别相反、彼此独立的Abel Kac--Moody代数。因此，同样的中心扩张边缘结构同时出现在渐近零类边界与有限距离的零类边界上。该相空间还容许电荷共轭扭曲的位形，其中代数的模式为半整数。最后，在闵可夫斯基时空中，我们在此扭曲扇区中找到了一个精确的辐射解，且两个荷均非零。
